source.title: SEOM-GECP-GETTHI clinical guidelines for the treatment of patients with thymic epithelial tumours (2021)
source.whyItFits: This open 2021 SEOM-GECP-GETTHI guideline covers diagnosis, Masaoka-Koga staging, surgery, radiotherapy, and chemotherapy for thymoma and thymic carcinoma. It is not limited to induction before resection. The ESMO guideline is not open.
